s: The Bardoli Satyagraha of 1928 was launched primarily against which of the following?
o: A ban on the cultivation of indigo
A punitive police tax imposed after a dacoity
A substantial enhancement of land revenue despite floods and famine
Compulsory recruitment into the colonial army
x: The Bardoli movement opposed an approximately 30 per cent increase in land revenue imposed despite floods and famine.
tq: Identify the specific issue rather than the leader or year.

s: Which one of the following correctly describes the method adopted during the Bardoli Satyagraha?
o: A disciplined no-tax campaign supported by a village intelligence network
An armed revolt supported by neighbouring princely states
A legal challenge before the Privy Council alone
A boycott of imported cloth without revenue refusal
x: Patel organised a disciplined no-tax campaign and maintained a village intelligence network during Bardoli Satyagraha.
tq: Distinguish the organisational method from the cause of the movement.
